description: This file defines a Container class that manages command execution, credential checks, and provider selection within a command runner session in a trading platform project.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: Container class for handling command execution, credential validation, and provider selection in a trading command runner session.

methods.name: None __init__(self, command_runner: "CommandRunner")

methods.name: Any _run(self, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Executes a command with default parameters, adapts output based on user preferences, and returns the result.

methods.name: Optional[bool] _check_credentials(self, provider: str)
methods.description: Checks whether the required credentials for a given provider are populated.

methods.name: str _get_provider( self, choice: Optional[str], command: str, default_priority: tuple[str, ...] )
methods.description: Determines which provider to use for a given command, based on user choice, credentials availability, and fallback priorities, raising an error if none are suitable.
